name: Nayarit

standard.note: Nayarit's plate is white with the state name and seal up top and a joyfully colorful band of folk-art patterns along the bottom.

plates.title: Current design (2022)
plates.fact: Nayarit's plate is white with the state name and seal up top and a joyfully colorful band of folk-art patterns along the bottom.

notes: The current design came with the 2022 general replating. In 2025-26 the Secretaría de Administración y Finanzas ran a 'Reemplacamiento 2026' drive with discounts, aimed at the roughly 200,000 vehicles still missing the 2022 replating (unotv, adn40). adn40 (Mar 2026) says the next general change is due in 2029. I found no clean official plate image: SAF's own graphic is a poster. hacienda.minayarit.gob.mx is the payment site. I found no specialty plates.
